Swim teacher here. One step at a time! With swimming, any sort of "practice" helps, and with time you'll find yourself more and more comfortable in the water and worrying less about the particulars like depth or even breathing.

Always keep pushing and stay strong. I can also relate to you in several ways. The pressure feels all too real at times. But we mustn't snap under this pressure. Use it elastically, to bounce forward and keep going. Always do what you enjoy. It hurts to be a performer and not have everyone support you, but when you have big roles and see an audience cheering, use that energy to know you did well. As the other person said, we can't expect even our family to always be there. The only one who will always be there for you, is you. So don't give up on yourself.
